name: Copilot
description: GitHub Copilot CLI: chat with Copilot inside {appName}. Works with every Copilot plan, Copilot Free included. Sign in with your GitHub account. Sign out by typing /logout inside the chat.

signIn.label: Sign in with GitHub (browser)…
signIn.tip: Opens GitHub in your browser to approve the sign-in. The app never sees your password.
signIn.intro: Signing in with your GitHub account. Your browser opens; finish there.

signIn.label: Sign in with GitHub (device code)…
signIn.tip: Shows a one-time code and a GitHub page to type it on, for when the browser can't open here.
signIn.intro: Copy the code shown here, then finish on the GitHub page.
